news_items.headline: Sam McDowell, inspiration for 'Cheers' character, dies at 84
news_items.description: Sam McDowell, who led the AL in strikeouts four times before becoming a counselor for athletes suffering from addiction and depression, has died at 84.

news_items.headline: Fred Claire, ex-Dodgers GM who oversaw 1988 WS team, dies at 91
news_items.description: Fred Claire, who parlayed early jobs as a sportswriter and editor into a 30-year career with the Dodgers in public relations and as a World Series-winning GM, has died. He was 91.

news_items.headline: Giants end Dodgers' 3-year run with most injured list days
news_items.description: San Francisco led the major leagues with 2,379 days on the injured list and 44 IL placements, ending the Dodgers streak of 3 consecutive seasons with the most, according to Major League Baseball.
